craft_notes: Sthāyin: Rati for sight and stay (abhilāṣa) settling into praise. Comma→dash after address (entrusting done, hoping released). Rejected: 'sometime' for 'karhicit' vagueness — kept ever/when. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Lodging word and thought and body's works in thee, O Master —
grown into thee, twinless: might we be — O ever, O when?
l4.sanskrit_cite: vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmāṇi viniyojya tvayi prabho tvanmayībhūya nirdvandvāḥ kaccit syāmāpi karhicit

reads_against.argmap: Having entrusted speech-mind-body acts in you, O Lord. → Entrusting all acts in you, may we become you-made and pair-free.
c1_essence: Veda-bodied wish-tree bowed; entrusting all acts to become you-made and pair-free.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-śānta with abhilāṣa (longing to see and stay)

l2.plain_english: Having entrusted speech, mind, body's acts in you, O Lord — become you-made, pair-free: may we be, at any time?
l2.sanskrit_cite: vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmāṇi viniyojya tvayi prabho tvanmayībhūya nirdvandvāḥ kaccit syāmāpi karhicit

l3: Lodging word and thought and body's works in thee, O Master —
grown into thee, twinless: might we be — O ever, O when?
reads_against.t1: Having entrusted speech-mind-body actions in you, O Lord, becoming you-made — may we be pair-free, even sometime.
